title: centratherum punctatum subsp. fruticosum
intro: Centratherum punctatum subsp. fruticosum, commonly known as the shrubby centratherum, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and treating skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the skin. Bioactive constituents present in the shrubby centratherum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
